d:
Winter is almost here, and we’re heading back to this secluded cabin. With Chillhop Sanctuary we return to the scene from dryhope’s 2019 EP ‘White Oak’, which we also used for the Chillhop Hideaway mix a couple of years ago. This time, snow is falling, the lake is frozen and the wood burner is on. It’s become one of our most loved visuals over the years, so we had to come back to it. Enjoy!
